# S7: Charts, media engagement (A, B, C)

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S7.md, and do S7. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 425,451p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (S7). Shared rules: [README.md](README.md). Can run in parallel with S8–S10 in a git worktree.

## Purpose
Step back from the story into the numbers: three D3 charts from the YouTube corpus (D11), each in its own short pinned stage.

## Allowed data keys
- D11 chart data (the one exception to "facts only from `data/story`", set by Vali): `data/youtube-coverage/cjp_youtube_coverage.json`, `data/data_profile.json`, `data/timeline_clips.json`, `data/channels.json`. Step 1 (spec): write the column mapping (x, y, series, size) for each chart into STATUS.
- `timeline.nodes[].{date, label}` for the story-node markers on chart A (no `victory` marker needed: the corpus stops at 21 Jul).
- Callouts computed from the corpus carry a `*` whose footer entry names the corpus and its collection date (`methodology.collection_dates`).

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s07-charts.js`: **one factory**, called three times with `def.sub = 0, 1, 2` (S7a line, S7b bubbles, S7c stream). Split into `src/scenes/s07/*.js` if it gets heavy.
- **D3 (D10):** add `d3-scale`, `d3-shape`, `d3-hierarchy`, `d3-array` (ESM, pinned) to the import map in `v3/index.html` if S5b hasn't already. The only shell edit allowed; log it in STATUS.

## Must not touch
The common list in README (except the import-map line above).

## Contracts it consumes
- Each chart is its own pinned block (`S7a`, `S7b`, `S7c`, 170vh each). Between blocks the stage scrolls away over 100vh, so p 1 of one chart and p 0 of the next are both on screen during the slide.
- `update(p)`: spec timings per chart: 0–0.20 title and axes, 0.20–0.70 scrubbed draw-in, 0.70–1 hold. Tooltips active at all times (pointer only; they never cover the hovered mark).
- `.reading` (paper in both themes); `--chart-*` tokens.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |
|---|---|---|
| S7a 0.75 | Chart A hold: summed views by upload day (IST), fully drawn; black line, red only for the peak; thin node markers with `node.label`; callouts with `*` on the right; kicker + title above. | `ink-S7.png` |
| S7b 0.75 | Chart B hold (channels, bubbles). | none: show Vali a static frame first |
| S7c 0.75 | Chart C hold (source type per day, stream/stacked). | none: show Vali a static frame first |

## Done when
- Three charts render from real data, animate with scroll both ways, are hover-inspectable (value, date, source), axes labelled with units, and match the data exactly.
- Reduced motion: final state immediately (M9 wires the global switch; make `update` accept it).
- QA both ways (`targets/S7.json`), compare sheets, `qa-shell` all PASS.

- The corpus is machine-tagged and unreviewed, and it stops at 21 Jul: say so in the chart note.
